description: Lists the addresses that pressed "this is spam" on this account's mail, with the day and the label their provider gave it. The account writes to none of them, and it does so SILENTLY: a message to one of these addresses is stopped before it leaves, with no bounce and nothing in the thread to see. So this is the list to read when a mail seems to have gone nowhere and nothing said why.
name: list_suppressed_recipients
title: List the addresses the account can no longer write to
